tools.name: list_upcoming_minimum_wage_changes
tools.description: Lists every scheduled or announced minimum wage change (state, county and city) in a date window, soonest first, with the new rate and source. Use it to plan payroll or warn an employer before a rate rises. Filter by state. Free.
